scope: Exploratory conditional restart from actual LLG states. All 12 conditions, original state plus two preselected parent paths at .2 and .4. Fixed 24000-update models; no fitting. 1024 repeats chosen for a fourfold sample count over prior validation, not power-sized. Whole fresh-noise paths are units within each fixed state; states share parent families and trajectories. Primary reference fine MT; coarse MT and Heun numerical controls. Analyze conditional mean, variance, neighbor and full covariance; no automatic certification.
